exceptions.purpose: RDOC_TRIGGER_FRAMES headless frame-number capture trigger, so unmodified third-party applications can be captured without a GUI. Upstream RenderDoc has no equivalent env control.

granted_by.note: That step granted this declared working-tree modification and simultaneously forbade every other tracked file.

provenance.scope_note: Narrowed from *.json after the F3 check rejected it: N3-02 and N3-03 were captured without the patch and record no mechanism, so only the N3-05A captures are covered by this exception. mechanism_path and recorded_path were removed from this declaration. They named capture_mechanism.patch and capture_mechanism.patch_recorded under rdebug-validation, and neither file exists anywhere; rdebug-validation/n3-corpus/build/patch_verification.json records verdict STOP with patch_verified_in_binary false, so no .rdc from that run may be admitted. A check that can only ever fail is not a check -- it invites fabrication. The provenance that IS verifiable stays: the metadata globs, the mechanism name, patch_recorded, the artefact digest and the base pin.

exceptions.scope_note: This exception authorises exactly the modification described above and nothing else. It does not carry forward to any future patch: a new patch must re-enter the same Contract and evidence flow and be declared separately.

exceptions.purpose: rdcspv::Init published glslang_inited before its two containers were allocated, so an allocation failure left the flag true with null pointers. Shutdown() then dereferenced NULL, and a later Init() silently did nothing. This restores the invariant that the flag means both containers are live.

granted_by.note: The attribution is binary-level: the fault at image offset 0x4A0A4E (mov rbx,[rax]) is rdcspv::Shutdown() dereferencing a null allocatedPrograms, with glslang_inited read but never reset anywhere in the module.

source_commit.note: This commit is where the change was written, not the baseline this exception audits against. It is deliberately not the verification base: the delivery model is a clean checkout of the public base with this patch applied as a working-tree modification. The sibling checkout still carries this commit, and the base pin is what reports that.

exceptions.excluded_surfaces_note: driver is absent here because this exception is scoped to exactly one file inside that directory, enforced by files and by the patch digest. excluded_surfaces is not executed by the verifier, so it is not what bounds this exception; the allowed_symbols list and the digest are.
